response.rationale: The item is electronics with days_since_delivery = 16, which is greater than 15. The electronics-specific rule RET-003 (priority 20) applies and dominates the standard 30-day window rules (priority 10). No higher-priority rule applies: item is not defective (RET-020), not final sale (RET-012), no goodwill grant (RET-050), and no fraud hold (RET-051). Therefore the return is ineligible.
